passages.sermon: This is a song for going up to Jerusalem.\r\nPeople sang this song as they traveled to worship God.\r\nThe song is called a "song of ascents."

passages.text: Come, bless the LORD, all you servants of the LORD who serve by night in the house of the LORD!
passages.sermon:
This is a song of ascents.
All servants of the LORD, bless the LORD.
You stand in the house of the LORD at night.
You serve the LORD there.
Bless the LORD.
passages.original: שִׁ֗יר הַֽמַּ֫עֲל֥וֹת הִנֵּ֤ה׀ בָּרֲכ֣וּ אֶת־ יְ֭הוָה כָּל־ עַבְדֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה הָעֹמְדִ֥ים בְּבֵית־ יְ֝הוָ֗ה בַּלֵּילֽוֹת׃

passages.text: Lift up your hands to the sanctuary and bless the LORD!
passages.sermon:
This is a song of ascents.
The servants of the LORD stand in the house of the LORD at night.
Lift up your hands toward the sanctuary.
Bless the LORD.
passages.original: שְׂאֽוּ־ יְדֵכֶ֥ם קֹ֑דֶשׁ וּ֝בָרֲכוּ אֶת־ יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: May the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth, bless you from Zion.
passages.sermon: The LORD is the Maker of heaven and earth.\r\nThe LORD is in Zion.\r\nMay the LORD bless you from Zion.
passages.original: יְבָרֶכְךָ֣ יְ֭הוָה מִצִּיּ֑וֹן עֹ֝שֵׂ֗ה שָׁמַ֥יִם וָאָֽרֶץ׃
